edges: The Recluse acquired and lived in the house before its destruction.
The Recluse lived with his faithful dog, Pepper.
The Recluse lived with his sister.
The Recluse experienced a vision of the Plain of Silence.
The Recluse was attacked by the swine-things.
The house transported the Recluse to the Sea of Sleep.
The Recluse's new dog was infected by a luminous fungal disease.
The malicious swine-beast followed the Recluse back to his own dimension.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The house was long believed to be evil before the unsociable old man acquired it.
The man delivered supplies to the house and later reported its mysterious fall into the chasm.
